title: Measured effect of the vqa_rad_open_train / vqamed_open MedPix overlap
probe: genframe_head_ens8 (the DEPLOYED probe, fitted without a leakage filter)
VERDICT: 19 of 3663 vqamed questions (0.519%) sit on an image the deployed probe trained on. Removing them moves verifier-minus-greedy from -0.0259 to -0.0261 (-0.00014). Immaterial: the contaminated questions are ones the model fails either way (verifier 0.0000, greedy 0.0000, oracle 0.1579), so the overlap cannot have inflated anything.
